title: The Surgeon of Saint Wend
text: A surgeon in a leather apron arrives with a cart of jars and a letter from a saint nobody has heard of. He offers his art to every House. He does not want gold; he wants material.

options.label: Give him a recruit to work with, and take the salves he leaves.

outcomes.text: He returns the recruit at dawn, stitched and smiling, unable to remember their own name. He leaves salves by the dozen.
He does not return the recruit. Instead he leaves a jar, and something in it knocks when you ask it questions.

options.label: Let him improve one of your Scions, praying his saint is a kind one.

outcomes.text: The graft takes. The new arm is stronger than the old one, and only twitches at night.
The graft takes badly. Your Scion screams for three days and comes out of it changed about the eyes.

options.label: Bar the door against him; whatever his saint is, it is not yours.

outcomes.text: He leaves a single jar on your step. Inside is an eye that follows you around the room.
